sentences.text:
Azhar Khan .....Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand and Another .....Respondents
Counsel for the Applicant : Mr. P.C. Petshali,
 Advocate.

Counsel for the State : Mr. Pankaj Joshi, Brief
 Holder.

Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. Yogesh Upadhyay,
No.2 Advocate.
Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

The present Application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed to quash the charge-sheet dated 01.05.2022, cognizance order dated 08.08.2022 and the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.4027 of 2022, "State vs. Azhar Khan", pending before the Court of Judicial Magistrate, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar, under Sections 498A, 323, 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, Section 3 and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2.
Today, the applicant - accused Azhar Khan and Smt. Sahiba, respondent no.2 - informant/ victim are present in-person before the National Lok Adalat with their counsel.

sentences.text: 1 3. The applicant - Azhar Khan is identified by Mr. P.C. Petshali, Advocate, and the respondent no.2 - Smt. Sahiba is identified by Mr. Yogesh Upadhyay, Advocate.
4. Mr. Pankaj Joshi, learned Brief Holder for the State.
5. The applicant and the respondent no.2 have settled their matrimonial disputes.
The applicant is the husband of the respondent no.2.
Both the parties have filed a Compromise Application.
6. The applicant and the respondent no.2 submitted that they have already filed a Compounding Application along with the affidavits with their free will and without any pressure.
7. Both the parties have requested to decide the present matter on the basis of the compromise.
8. The Compromise Application is verified.
9. Learned counsel for the State has submitted that there were matrimonial disputes between the parties and they have resolved their disputes.
Therefore, the State has no objection to the Compounding Application.

10. Keeping in view the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the view that ends of justice would be met, if the charge-sheet dated 01.05.2022, cognizance order dated 08.08.2022 and the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.4027 of 2022, "State vs. Azhar Khan",
pending before the Court of Judicial Magistrate, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar, are quashed.

11. Resultantly, the charge-sheet dated 01.05.2022, cognizance order dated 08.08.2022 and the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.4027 of 2022, "State vs. Azhar Khan", pending before the Court of Judicial Magistrate, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar, are quashed.
12. The Criminal Misc. Application (No.829 of 2024), filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, is disposed of accordingly.

ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
Dated : 11th May, 2024 JKJ/Pant Azhar Khan vs State Of Uttarakhand And Another on 11 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53314720/
